CoopRoom.title: CoopRoom
CoopRoom.description: Cloud multiplayer room for 4-player Co-op matches keyed by a 6-digit Room Code.

roomCode.description: 4-12 char alphanumeric Room Code matching the document ID.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room Host (immutable after creation).

hostName.description: Display callsign of the Host commander.

status.description: Lifecycle phase of the online match.

openForJoin.description: Whether new remote players with the room code may join in LOBBY.

memberUids.description: Up to 4 authenticated Firebase UIDs participating in the room.

spawnAiEnemyIfSameFaction.description: Whether same-faction Co-op auto-spawns an AI opposition wave.

players.description: Up to 4 commander slot maps (id, name, faction, slotMode, ready, connectedClient, uid).

assignedUnits.description: Up to 40 squad assignment maps (entryId, ownerPlayerId, templateId).

battleState.description: Optional live tactical battle snapshot map written by Host while ACTIVE/FINISHED.

CoopAction.title: CoopAction
CoopAction.description: Tactical turn action command submitted by a remote Co-op client for the Host to execute.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player submitting the command.

hostUid.description: Denormalized Host UID of the parent room for scoped listening and cleanup.

actionType.description: Action identifier (TAP_WORLD, TOGGLE_MOVE, ADVANCE, SET_CM, WALK_CM, CONFIRM_MOVE, CANCEL_MOVE, TOGGLE_CHARGE, CONFIRM_CHARGE, CANCEL_CHARGE, STRIKE, WEAPON_MODE, ROTATE, END_TURN).

/coop_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Online 4-player Co-op rooms indexed by Room Code.

/coop_rooms/{roomCode}/actions/{actionId.description: Remote player turn commands relayed to the room Host.
